hypotheses.text: If Mateo Brann (CF) had been 5 m closer to Felix Ondo, the chance to score would have been meaningfully reduced, showing preventing space in front of the shooter could have stopped the goal.

If Ruben Saldo (CB) had been 5 m closer to Felix Ondo, the shot opportunity would have been significantly harder and likely prevented, indicating tighter central defensive pressure was a key prevention measure.
